title: Portfolio header
description: The intro at the top of a personal portfolio, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Button, Indicator and Skeleton primitives: an Avatar, an availability Indicator, the person's name as a serif h1, their role, a short bio and a row of links, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the role and bio step up at @sm, the name steps up and the avatar moves beside the text at @md, and the header gets more room at @lg.
